# Accuracy: the model against measured figures

`scripts/accuracy.py` computes every predicted value from `workingset.model`. Error = (predicted − measured) / measured. Positive means the model over-estimates.

Few public measurements match a configuration the model prices, so the counts are small. A figure that set one of the model's constants is in [Fitted anchors](#fitted-anchors), outside the error statistics: agreement there proves nothing.

## Summary

Independent measurements only: none of these set a constant.

| quantity | n | mean error | mean absolute error | largest error |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KV pool | 1 | +0.26% | 0.26% | +0.26% |
| Weight bytes | 3 | +0.01% | 0.02% | +0.05% |
| Decode speed per user | 3 | +10.5% | 10.5% | +23.4% |
| Prefill, idle cold TTFT | 1 | -14.4% | 14.4% | -14.4% |

Not yet checked against any independent public measurement:

- **Prefill on H200.** The prefill MFU (0.45) rests on measurements this repo does not publish (research/prefill.md). The one prefill measurement, Kimi-K3.1-Pro's, is on B300.
- **Decode step time on B300** for any model but Mistral-Large-4, and that one runs on GB300. InferenceX's B300 curves are tagged `calibrate` and sit in the fitted table.
- **Decode step time on H200** beyond the 27B sweep the constants were read on.
- **Cache hit rate and warm capacity.** research/agentx_kv_hits.md compares the AgentX simulation with InferenceX's hit rates; the simulation takes minutes per seed and is not rerun here, and those rates are tagged `calibrate`.
- **TTFT under load, queue wait, users per box.** No public measurement.
- **Power and energy.** The constants are H100 proxies and B300 extrapolations (research/power.md); nothing measured on H200 or B300.
- **Models with no independent row.** Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B (dense), GLM-5.3 (MoE 744B-A40B, MLA+DSA), DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (MoE 284B-A13B, CSA), DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (MoE 284B-A13B, CSA, vision), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (MoE 552B+196B Engram, CED+CSA2), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (MoE 125B-A6B, QSA+n-gram), GLM-5.3-Flash (MoE 320B-A18B, KDA+NoPE-MLA).

## What the model does not take as input

### GPU memory cap and draft setting (KV pool)

By default the model sizes the pool from the whole HBM less a fixed reserve. The memory cap is an input only through `calibration.gpu_memory_utilization`, one of the reserve terms `ws calibrate --vllm-log` reads from a start-up log (research/reserve_terms.md); the drafter is not an input. vLLM recipes report pools at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85` and without a drafter, whose cache rows the model charges, and the rows below are priced at the default reserve, so they mix both effects:

| conditions | measured | predicted | error | source | date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mistral-Large-4 FP8, 8×B300 TP8 | 2.380M | 2.690M | +13.0% | vLLM recipe, 8×GB300 at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85`, no drafter (research/model_mistral_large4.md § 2) | 2026-10-30 |
| Mistral-Large-4 NVFP4, 8×B300 TP8 | 3.600M | 3.884M | +7.9% | vLLM recipe, 8×GB300 at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85`, no drafter (research/model_mistral_large4.md § 2) | 2026-10-30 |
| Mistral-Large-4 FP8, 8×B300 DCP8 | 18.880M | 21.516M | +14.0% | vLLM recipe, 8×GB300 at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85`, no drafter (research/model_mistral_large4.md § 2) | 2026-10-30 |

### Engine

One set of decode constants serves every engine. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 8×H100 at the lowest concurrency: vLLM TP8 361 tok/s per user, SGLang TP8 EP8 135 (InferenceX, read 2026-11-04): ×2.7 between engines on the same GPUs.

### Workload behind the acceptance

Acceptance is one number per model. InferenceX measures DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 5 drafts at 4.07 tokens per step with thinking off and 3.51 with it on, +16.0% from the prompt alone.

### One long sequence decoding alone

The step equation has no term for it. The sweep's n = 1, 114k row is -11.2% (fitted table).

### Hybrid-allocator state pages

The 27B TP2 FP16 log reports 2 × 110.59 GiB of KV memory; its 3,233,564 tokens at FP16 fill 197.4 GiB of it, leaving 23.8 GiB the allocator holds for DeltaNet state. The model charges state per live session instead and does not predict that figure.

### Also not taken, unsized

- FP4 weights on Hopper: InferenceX runs them on H200; the model prices FP8 there.
- Sparse attention in prefill: DSA layers are priced as dense attention, an upper bound on prefill time.
- The decode step jump past n ≈ 64 (issue #74).
- Per-deployment reserves (CUDA graphs, a lowered memory cap): `ws calibrate --vllm-log` reads the reserve, or its three terms, from the start-up log; the default does not.
